mapper.select: SELECT m.code as m_code, m.id as m_id, m.ranking as m_ranking, m.rating as m_rating, i.path, ifnull(count(cl.cmt_code), 0) AS count_like, c.* FROM comments c JOIN member_account m ON c.mem_code = m.code LEFT JOIN comment_like cl ON cl.cmt_code = c.code LEFT JOIN images i ON i.target_code = m.code AND i.delete_yn = 0 AND type = 'profile' WHERE feed_code = #{code} GROUP BY c.code
